considerations: Confirm whether an administrator or endpoint policy created the exclusion.
Review files written into newly excluded folders.
description: Review Defender exclusions that reference remote-support staging or RelayTrap.

evidence.claim: Microsoft documented unauthorized ScreenConnect sessions, scripting, scheduled tasks, Run keys and changes to Defender exclusions while investigating SCKit.
evidence.location: Investigation guidance and advanced hunting examples

expected_output: One row per matching event in tabular mode. A match supports triage.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Review Defender exclusions that reference remote-support staging or RelayTrap.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Defender Path Exclusions Near SCKit Activity

1.json:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ActionType == "RegistryValueSet"
| where RegistryKey contains @"\Windows Defender\Exclusions\Paths"
| where RegistryValueName contains "ConnectWiseControl" or RegistryValueName contains "CWInstall" or RegistryValueName contains "RelayTrap" or RegistryValueData contains "RelayTrap"
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
